service.name: plan-manager
service.description: Planning runtime and single authority for plan logic: a guided wizard that makes authoring and executing implementation plans cheap enough for local models, with first-class phases, computed staleness, and baseline-aware validation.

setup.description: Build API and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o plan-manager-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie

code-facts.description: Resolves `[CODE:]` references and provides structural facts that feed staleness (the `validation` domain).
code-facts.degraded_behavior: References remain recorded but unresolved; staleness is reported as unknown. Other flows continue.

git-control-tower.description: Captures and diffs the regression anchor (baseline snapshot/diff) used by authoring autofill and DoD verification.
git-control-tower.degraded_behavior: Anchor autofill is skipped and flagged; DoD verification reports anchor-unavailable rather than failing.

test-genie.description: Runs this scenario's phased test suite and owns project/scenario validation results consumed (not owned) for plan health.
test-genie.degraded_behavior: Plan-health validation reads are reported unavailable; the plan still records its own validation state.

prompt-manager.description: Executes the skill/action discovery probes behind authoring's server-side context discovery (`prompt-manager discover --json`).
prompt-manager.degraded_behavior: The affected discovery probes return typed degraded candidates; the wizard continues and the author can submit context directly or record an honest skip.

meta-optimization-manager.description: Velocity signal sink (trials) for per-plan time/tokens/iterations.
meta-optimization-manager.degraded_behavior: Velocity is retained locally and emit is retried later; no flow blocks.

agent-manager.description: Provides the run-id attribution contract (VROOLI_AGENT_MANAGER_RUN_ID) used to dedup handoff actions. Owns the prose-handoff capture (it holds the transcript); plan-manager links to it by reference and never reads transcripts.
agent-manager.degraded_behavior: Handoff dedup falls back to content-based best-effort; structured handoff still assembles.

search-hub.description: Executes the recall probe behind authoring's server-side context discovery (`search-hub query --json`) and reference suggestion.
search-hub.degraded_behavior: The recall probe returns a typed degraded candidate (per-probe timeout bounds slow queries); the wizard continues without recall results.
